    paint += sample(noise, wx, wy)[..., None]*.34

def warped_foreground(t, grip, tip):
    v = tip-grip
    L = np.linalg.norm(v)
    u = v/L
    n = np.array([-u[1], u[0]], np.float32)
    # Inverse warp for the shaft: retain its pixel width while changing only
    # foreshortening along its photographic axis.
    xx=x-grip[0]; yy=y-grip[1]
    along=(xx*u[0]+yy*u[1])*L0/L
    cross=xx*n[0]+yy*n[1]
    sx=g0[0]+along*u0[0]+cross*n0[0]
    sy=g0[1]+along*u0[1]+cross*n0[1]
    shaft_a=sample(shaft,sx,sy)
    shaft_c=sample(I,sx,sy)
    # A thin coating at the submerged end acquires the current blended pigment.
    wet = smoothstep((along-(L0-5.0))/5.0) * shaft_a
    blend = smoothstep((t-.5)/3.7)

    a = np.arctan2(u[1],u[0])-np.arctan2(u0[1],u0[0])

    # out of view, rather than reflecting an artificial bright edge into frame.

    effective,phi,tip,grip=stirring(t)

    paint=liquid(t,tip,phi,effective)

    out=out*(1-ha[...,None])+hc*ha[...,None]

# with nearby pixels. The lower part is replaced by moving liquid below.
shaft_remove = ((shaft > .06) & (hand < .5)).astype(np.uint8)*255
shaft_remove = cv2.dilate(shaft_remove, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8))
plate = cv2.inpaint(np.uint8(np.clip(plate, 0, 255)), shaft_remove, 4, cv2.INPAINT_TELEA).astype(np.float32)

# Original lighting separated from the red/blue pigment, excluding the shaft.

valid = fluid * (1-shaft) * (1-hand)
shade = blur(np.clip(shade0, .55, 1.17)*valid, 2.4) / np.maximum(blur(valid, 2.4), 1e-4)
shade = np.clip(shade, .67, 1.11)
# Original fine paint grain is retained and transported by the swirl.
texture0 = np.clip(shade0-shade, -.055, .055) * valid
texture0 = blur(texture0, .48)

# Extract the original red/blue boundary, including its slight irregular shape.
seam = np.full(H, 133., np.float32)
for row in range(34, 137):
    xx = np.where((rgb_b[row] > rgb_r[row]*1.12) & (np.arange(W)>119) & (np.arange(W)<157) & (fluid[row]>.1))[0]

seam = cv2.GaussianBlur(seam[:, None], (1, 9), 1.6)[:, 0]
F0 = .5 + .5*np.tanh((seam[:, None]-x)/.75)

# Use 2x pixel-space sampling for gently rounded, subpixel paint grooves.
S = 2
ys, xs = np.mgrid[:H*S, :W*S].astype(np.float32)
xs = (xs+.5)/S-.5; ys = (ys+.5)/S-.5

BLUE = np.array([0., 80., 212.], np.float32)
PURPLE = np.array([108., 30., 139.], np.float32)
phi0 = 4*np.pi/3


def stirring(t):
    # Rapid turns, easing slightly once the paint is fully blended.
    effective = t - (.28/1.2)*max(t-3.25, 0.)**2
    phi = phi0 + 2*np.pi*1.2*effective
    c, s = np.cos(phi), np.sin(phi)
    tip = np.array([128.+23.*c, 86.+(14./(.5*np.sqrt(3)))*s], np.float32)
    grip = g0 + np.array([8.5*(c-np.cos(phi0)), 4.4*(s-np.sin(phi0))], np.float32)
    return effective, phi, tip, grip


def liquid(t, tip, phi, effective):
    # An inverse coordinate warp rolls the two original pigment regions into
    # irregular stretching ribbons. No quantities are evolved or simulated.
    strength = smoothstep(t/.35)
    radius_perturb = .017*strength*np.sin(3*theta+9*rad-1.35*effective)
    radius_perturb += .009*strength*np.sin(7*theta-13*rad+2.1*effective)
    rr = np.maximum(rad + radius_perturb*np.clip(1-rad*.5, 0, 1), 0.)
    turn = effective*(3.8 + 10.*np.clip(1-rr, 0, 1)**1.45)
    turn += .23*strength*np.sin(3*theta+8*rr-2.4*effective)*np.clip(1-rr, 0, 1)
    aa = theta-turn
    wx = cx + rx*rr*np.cos(aa)
    wy = cy + ry*rr*np.sin(aa)
    f = sample(F0, wx, wy)
    f = blur(f, (.30+.34*t+.12*t*t)*S)
    blended = smoothstep((t-.50)/3.70)
    contrast = (1-blended)**1.05
    signed = 2*f-1
    # The transition between pigments is already purple; remaining saturated
    # ribbons shrink and lose contrast as each stroke blends them.
    rw = np.maximum(signed, 0.)**.90 * contrast
    bw = np.maximum(-signed, 0.)**.90 * contrast
    paint = PURPLE + rw[..., None]*(RED-PURPLE) + bw[..., None]*(BLUE-PURPLE)
    grain = sample(texture0, wx, wy)
    paint *= (shade_hi + grain*.65)[..., None]

    phase = 31.*rad + 2.4*theta - 2.6*effective + 2.6*np.sin(2*theta+3*rad-effective*.35)
    phase2 = 47.*rad - 3.8*theta - 1.7*effective + np.sin(5*theta+7*rad)
    edge = np.clip((1.03-rad)/.13, 0, 1)
    center = smoothstep(rad/.14)
    waves = (2.2*np.sin(phase)+1.3*np.sin(phase2))*center*edge
    crest = np.exp(-((np.sin(phase/2))/.105)**2)
    crest2 = np.exp(-((np.sin(phase2/2))/.085)**2)
    illumination = np.clip(.5-.35*np.sin(theta), .1, .85)
    ridge = (crest*12.0+crest2*5.0)*illumination*center*edge

    activity = strength*(.75+.25*contrast)
    paint += (waves + ridge - valley)[..., None]*activity*np.array([.82, .74, 1.], np.float32)

def warped_foreground(t, grip, tip):
    v = tip-grip
    L = np.linalg.norm(v)
    u = v/L
    n = np.array([-u[1], u[0]], np.float32)
    # Inverse warp for the shaft: retain its pixel width while changing only
    # foreshortening along its photographic axis.
    xx=x-grip[0]; yy=y-grip[1]
    along=(xx*u[0]+yy*u[1])*L0/L
    cross=xx*n[0]+yy*n[1]
    sx=g0[0]+along*u0[0]+cross*n0[0]
    sy=g0[1]+along*u0[1]+cross*n0[1]
    shaft_a=sample(shaft,sx,sy)
    shaft_c=sample(I,sx,sy)
    # A thin coating at the submerged end acquires the current blended pigment.
    wet = smoothstep((along-(L0-5.0))/5.0) * shaft_a
    blend = smoothstep((t-.5)/3.7)
    wet_color = (PURPLE*blend + RED*(1-blend))*0.78
    shaft_c=shaft_c*(1-wet[...,None]*.45) + wet_color*wet[...,None]*.45
    # Hand rotates rigidly about the grip, attached to the moving stirrer.
    a = np.arctan2(u[1],u[0])-np.arctan2(u0[1],u0[0])
    ca,sa=np.cos(a),np.sin(a)
    hx=g0[0]+ca*xx+sa*yy
    hy=g0[1]-sa*xx+ca*yy
    hand_a=sample(hand,hx,hy)
    # The source hand is cropped at the upper image edge; extrapolate the wrist
    # out of view, rather than reflecting an artificial bright edge into frame.
    hand_a *= (hy < 38) & (hx > 0) & (hx < 102)
    hand_c=sample(I,hx,hy)
    return shaft_c,shaft_a,hand_c,hand_a


def frame(t):
    effective,phi,tip,grip=stirring(t)
    out=plate.copy()
    paint=liquid(t,tip,phi,effective)
    out=out*(1-fluid[...,None])+paint*fluid[...,None]
    sc,sa,hc,ha=warped_foreground(t,grip,tip)
    # A short soft contact shadow anchors the stick in the paint surface.
    sh=sample(shaft,x+1.8,y-1.0)
    # The contact shadow follows the actual current foreground alpha.
    sh=blur(sa,1.25)*fluid*.095
    out *= (1-sh[...,None])
    out=out*(1-sa[...,None])+sc*sa[...,None]
    out=out*(1-ha[...,None])+hc*ha[...,None]
    return out


def main():
    frames=[SRC.copy()]
    for k in range(1,20):
        t=k/4.
        # A short exposure gives natural motion blur at vigorous stirring speed.
        exposure=.030 if t<3.5 else .020
        shots=[frame(t+offset) for offset in [-exposure,0.,exposure]]
        frames.append(np.uint8(np.clip(np.mean(shots,axis=0)+.5,0,255)))
    frames=np.stack(frames)
    artifact_io.save(frames,CASE)

    print('Saved',frames.shape,'RGB frames; frame 00 matches the input exactly.')
    print('Final paint RGB mean:',frames[-1][fluid>.98].mean(axis=0).round(1).tolist())


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
